subject: Rivermark demo — travel extension & proposed alternatives
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermarkhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync — Rivermark demo slot confirmation

Hi Alyssa —

Following up to lock the demo for this week. We penciled in Thursday 13 May at 10:00 AM PT (60 min) for a full product walkthrough + Q&A. Agenda attached (high level product demo, integration touchpoints, pricing overview). Marcus will lead the technical portion; I’ll cover ROI and the rollout options.

If that still works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short prep note for your team. If not, what windows look good next week?

Attachments: 20270510-demo_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermarkhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Klein <tom.klein@rivermarkevents.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Rivermark demo slot confirmation

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the agenda. Unfortunately there’s been a last-minute extension to the on-site field week at our South Bay facility — several of our stakeholders got pulled into vendor briefings and we won’t be back in the office until the 18th. That means the Thursday 13 May time won’t work for the core group.

Two thoughts from our side:
1) If you can do a compressed 45–60 minute executive summary on the 18th (we’re free 09:00–11:00 PT), that would be helpful.
2) Alternatively, if your team can record the deep-dive (30–40 minute feature walkthrough + annotated slides) and we watch asynchronously, we could follow up with a 30–45 minute live Q&A later the week of the 19th with the engineers.

If recording is an option, Tom (cc’d) coordinates our internal distribution.

Appreciate the flexibility —
Alyssa Gomez
Senior Program Manager, Rivermark Health
alyssa.gomez@rivermarkhealth.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermarkhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Rivermark demo slot confirmation

Hi Alyssa —

Totally understand — thanks for the heads up. Recording is absolutely an option and will likely be the smoother path given your stakeholder spread. Two options from our side so you can pick what’s lowest friction:

Option A — Compressed executive summary (live)
- 18 May, 09:30–10:30 PT (60 min)
- Short executive slides + 25–30 minute live demo focusing on workflows you called out, followed by 20–25 minutes Q&A
- Marcus will present the demo; I’ll handle business questions

Option B — Recorded deep-dive + live office hours
- We record a 35–40 minute walkthrough with annotated slides and share by EOD Friday 14 May (MP4 + slide deck).
- Live office hours: Wed 19 May, 10:00–10:45 PT for Q&A with Marcus and our Solutions Engineering team
- Monica (cc) will publish the recording to a secure Drive folder and send recipient instructions so Tom can distribute internally

We can do both if you prefer — record the deep-dive and still do a short exec summary on the 18th. I’ve attached a one-page condensed executive summary calendar (.ics) for Option A to make scheduling easier.

Attachments: 20270514-condensed_exec_summary.ics (Calendar invite stub)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3x-demo-materials

Which option works best for your team? If Option B, we’ll aim to have the recording up by the 14th so your team has time to review before office hours.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Gomez <alyssa.gomez@rivermarkhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Klein <tom.klein@rivermarkevents.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Rivermark demo slot confirmation

Hi Tessa / team —

Thanks — Option B sounds ideal for us given the stakeholder availability. Please proceed with the recorded deep-dive and share the link by EOD Friday the 14th as you suggested. We’ll plan to have the live Q&A on Wednesday 19 May at 10:00 AM PT. Tom will circulate the recording and the calendar invite to the group.

A couple of quick asks for the recording:
- Could you include a short segment (3–4 minutes) on data residency and retention (we have compliance folks who always ask about that)?
- Add one slide with integration touchpoints for Cerner/EPIC (we use both at different facilities).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’ll confirm the attendee list once Tom has routed it.

Best —
Alyssa
